description: Sets the optic mode of the current weapon to the given class name or the index.
examples: <sqf>player setOpticsMode "Hamr2Scope"; // Default optic mode for optic_Hamr</sqf>
<sqf>player setOpticsMode [1, 0]; // reset the optics mode of the player's primary weapon to the default</sqf>
